The '''Forward Command Shield of Duty''' was a decorative badge awarded by [[Imperial Forward Command]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
This item appeared in Game Update 2.6: [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|Galactic Starfighter]] of the the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Prototype (medium) reputation trophy for Imperial faction player characters to earn reputation points with Imperial Forward Command.<ref name="FCSoD" /> The trophy was obtained by playing the Kuat Drive Yards Flashpoint.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=flashpoint|Kuat Drive Yards}}</ref>
